fields.description: EEPROM validity word at save offset 0x00. Baseline holds LE u32 0xDEADD0D0 (3735933136) in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001738 loads 0x48 bytes via FUN_08075134 into buffer param_1+0x24, then compares *(int*)(iVar1+8) (== save+0x00) against ROM literal-pool constant DAT_080018ac, and stores DAT_080018ac there on the first-boot init path before rewriting the block via FUN_08074fe4.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: First word of the 64-byte defaults/gameplay block at save+0x04. FUN_08001738 populates this region from save+0x04 via FUN_0807cc64 ROM-table defaults on init; exact gameplay role is unresolved (zero in fresh baseline) so it is exposed as a mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001738 passes param_1+0x28 (== save+0x04) as the destination of FUN_0807cc64 on the init path; the 0x48-byte buffer is zero-filled by FUN_08064f9c, transported by FUN_08074fe4/FUN_08075134, and covered by the FUN_080664a4 checksum.
fields.name: block_head_word

fields.description: Remainder of the 64-byte defaults/gameplay block (save+0x08..save+0x44). Zero in the fresh baseline; transported and checksummed as part of the 0x48-byte block.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001738 moves the whole 0x48-byte buffer (param_1+0x24) with FUN_08075134 (load) / FUN_08074fe4 (store), zero-fills it with FUN_08064f9c, and checksums it with FUN_080664a4.
fields.name: progress_data

fields.description: Stored CRC-16 of the 0x48-byte block at save+0x44. Baseline holds LE u16 0x20FF (8447). The algorithm is custom (not in Schema v2's list), so it is a data field, not a checksums[] entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001738 reads *(short*)(param_1+0x68) (== save+0x44), zeroes it, recomputes FUN_080664a4 over the 0x48 bytes, and compares; FUN_080664a4 is a table-driven reflected CRC-16 using table DAT_08006580 with init DAT_0800657c.
fields.name: save_checksum_crc16

fields.description: Checksummed zero trailer at save+0x46. Exposed as a mutable scalar for completeness of the 0x48-byte coverage.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001738 covers save bytes [0x00,0x48) with FUN_080664a4, so save+0x46..0x48 participates in the checksum; the region is zero-filled by FUN_08064f9c and transported by FUN_08074fe4/FUN_08075134.
fields.name: block_trailer

magic_signatures.description: EEPROM validity word: LE u32 0xDEADD0D0 at save offset 0x00 (rev8-logical domain), compared against DAT_080018ac in FUN_08001738.
